idea.hook: THIS CAPTION GETS IGNORED. THIS ONE GETS DMS.

slides.heading: THIS CAPTION GETS IGNORED. THIS ONE GETS **DMS**.
slides.body: Same home. Same photos. Only the words change.

slides.heading: A CAPTION THAT SAYS **NOTHING**
slides.body: "Beautiful house for sale. Very nice and spacious. DM for more info and price." It could be any house, anywhere.

slides.heading: BUYERS SCROLL RIGHT **PAST**
slides.body: Nothing tells them why to stop. No size, no area, no price. So they move on to the next post.

slides.heading: THE SAME FIVE **LINES**, EVERY TIME
slides.body: Hook, basics, three highlights, price and location, one action. It's text only. It takes about five minutes.

slides.heading: LINE 1: LEAD WITH THE **HOOK**
slides.body:
Before: Beautiful house for sale.
After: Pool, garden and quiet street, close to schools.

slides.heading: LINES 2–3: **BASICS** AND HIGHLIGHTS
slides.body:
Before: Very nice and spacious.
After: 4 bedrooms · 4 bathrooms · for sale
✓ Gated, 24-hour security
✓ Fitted kitchen
✓ 5 minutes to the main road

slides.heading: LINES 4–5: PRICE, PLACE, **ACTION**
slides.body:
Before: DM for more info and price.
After: [Price] · [Area, City]
✓ DM "TOUR" to book a viewing.

slides.heading: GET THE **5-LINE** CAPTION
slides.body: Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook

caption:
Most listing captions say nothing. Here's the same home, written two ways.

Before: "Beautiful house for sale. Very nice and spacious. DM for more info and price."
After: a hook, the basics, three highlights, price and location, and one clear action.
Same house. Same photos. Only the words changed.
It's text only, and it takes about five minutes.
